shows.title: lucky/bird
shows.description: The Lucky make up a tight-knit community of Black folks with a murky past. And each summer they honor their shared history with a parade. Louise, a pariah, a three-time widow, raises peacocks on her front porch. On the eve of the parade, Louise and her birds are visited by a mysterious stranger—a spirit? or a figment of Louise's imagination?

shows.title: Beyond Words
shows.description: Alex is an African Grey parrot. Irene is a researcher at Harvard University. Over the protests of her male colleagues, Irene teaches Alex to meaningfully communicate and solve problems at the level of a 5-year-old child. This highly theatrical new work tracks their 30-year research experiment turned love story and captures man's longing to "talk with the animals." Inspired by the true life collaboration of Dr. Irene Pepperberg, and Alex.
